info.name: Semantic segmentation
info.description: Semantic segmentation with any classes. Decodes the run-box labels written by the Segmentation Labeler extension (the classes are the project's labels plus the background) and trains a MobileNetV2 + LR-ASPP network with a FOMO-compatible output, so it deploys like FOMO.

parameters.name: Number of training cycles
parameters.help: Epochs. With a few hundred images, 60-100 is a good range.

parameters.name: Learning rate
parameters.help: Initial Adam learning rate; decays with a cosine schedule.

parameters.name: Backbone width
parameters.help: MobileNetV2 width multiplier. 0.35 is the fastest on the Arduino UNO Q CPU.

parameters.name: Class threshold per cell
parameters.help: An output cell is trained as a class if at least this share of its labeled area has that class (the largest one wins), otherwise as background. Lower keeps small objects.

parameters.name: Foreground loss weight
parameters.help: Extra weight on cells of any class but the background: objects cover far fewer cells, and missing one costs more than a false alarm.

parameters.name: Data augmentation
parameters.help: Horizontal flips, zoom crops, lighting and noise. No vertical flips or rotation.

parameters.name: Output resolution
parameters.help: 1/8 matches FOMO and deploys through Edge Impulse. 1/4 is finer but not verified with Edge Impulse deployment.

parameters.name: Background class name
parameters.help: The extension's default class (Classes tab). It has no boxes, so Studio doesn't list it; this only names output channel 0.

parameters.name: Ignore label
parameters.help: Cells mostly labeled with this are left out of training. Leave blank if the extension has no ignore class.

parameters.name: Label grid columns
parameters.help: Must match the extension's label grid (Classes tab → Learning block settings).

parameters.name: Label grid rows
parameters.help: Must match the extension's label grid (Classes tab → Learning block settings).
